notes: Spec asserts two bullets: (1) session appears in ready within 1s of agent launch and (2) PID bound within 1s. Both phases anchor to recording start (agent launch) and budget 1000ms, unpinned so either the generic proc-<PID> pre-session row or the real UUID-keyed session may satisfy them. Muse's own session.jsonl (with route_facts.pid) is live-measured to materialize well under 1s after launch, unlike claudecode/codex's lazy transcript materialization -- so unlike those adapters muse does not strictly need the pre-session row to cover the window, but the spec stays unpinned to match the fleet-wide session-start convention. The recipe's send+wait_turn steps exercise the real transcript parser end to end (proving the ready->working->ready arc + zero tool calls) but this spec deliberately asserts nothing about that turn's own content -- those assertions live with basic-turn, matching claudecode/pi/copilot's committed 1-1_session-start cells.
